scope: Read-only critical check of report.json/review.html, EARLY4/5 and normalization of factory10/11 findings

refinements.recommendation: Reclassify from rejection/P1/confirmed assembly failure to adjustments/P2/editorial finish concern.
refinements.confirmed_fact: The south boundary copies wall.crop((0,80,256,112)) at y352, mirrored horizontally for the second half.
refinements.not_proven: Its crop provenance alone does not prove a broken asset. The visible band closes the bottom of the world, meets both side walls and begins at the walk boundary. It can represent a foreground wall/gate continuing beyond the world edge.
refinements.proposed_wording: O fechamento sul reaproveita a faixa inferior da parede norte. Funciona como limite arquitetônico de primeiro plano, mas a transição piso/parede, sem um coroamento próprio, pode receber acabamento para tornar a perspectiva mais clara. Não há fragmento isolado interno comprovado.

refinements.recommendation: Keep P2 spatial continuity as an editorial judgment, not a proven impossible building identity.
refinements.confirmed_fact: Stage4 uses a dark brick/steel/shutter interior; stage5 shows arches, cloth and an older facade.
refinements.not_proven: Different inside/outside materials do not establish that they cannot belong to the same adapted building. The blue entrance is a possible shared cue.
refinements.proposed_wording: A ligação visual entre o interior4 e o pátio5 é fraca; um elemento arquitetônico comum mais claro ajudaria a reconhecer o mesmo galpão.

refinements.recommendation: Retain as the strongest independent confirmed composition defect for10/11.
refinements.confirmed_fact: A partial blue machinery housing from the lower perimeter is pasted as a supposed horizontal conduit and opaquely overwrites internal conveyor pixels. This occurs inside the map and is independent of viewport edges.
refinements.wording_note: Avoid relying on emotive terms such as mutilated; source fragment, destination rectangles and paint order are sufficient evidence.

refinements.recommendation: Keep P2 truncation finding but remove quantitative claim cut in half.
refinements.confirmed_fact: The source crop ends at x48 through a column whose visible face continues to approximately55; the side face/lamp is cut.
refinements.not_proven: There was no exact50percent width measurement.
refinements.proposed_title: Face lateral e luminária dos pilares inferiores truncadas

refinements.recommendation: Keep static geometry observation; treat the requirement for a blocking base as design judgment pending movement/depth probe, rather than a demonstrated runtime failure.
refinements.confirmed_fact: The three cabinet footprints are absent from factory solids and the candidate16x16 footprints at(168,184),(392,184),(616,184) are statically free.
refinements.not_proven: This review has not recorded Damião crossing the painted machine base. Some background machinery may intentionally be decorative/walkable. Its apparent volume suggests checking this, but does not by itself establish a technical bug.
refinements.suggested_priority: P2 until explicit collision/depth expectation or recorded crossing confirms an actionable mismatch

refinements.recommendation: Replace the original46/292 claim with the qualified table below; do not count valve2 as wholly independent from the already-overpainted conveyor defect.
refinements.proposed_title: Válvula3 cobre a esteira; válvula2 ocupa a extremidade já sobrescrita pelo falso tubo
refinements.method: Recreate indexed factory source with current generator palette; crop(152,200,392,248), nearest resize112x40, extend to160x40 exactly as lines67..71. Recreate stamp_obj border flood background indices{5,13,6}. Count valve0 RGBA alpha pixels inside that retained conveyor mask at ground-snapped valve positions(384,184)/(608,184). Finally remove the opaque horizontal conduit rectangles(128,200,48,16),(352,200,48,16),(576,200,48,16), which are painted after the conveyors.

Physical overlap is proven for valve3; whether a valve is deliberately mounted on machinery remains a visual-integration/design question.

refinements.recommendation: Keep the framing observation, downgrade priority to P2 editorial/environment readability rather than a broken-asset claim.

refinements.not_proven: The environment is not absent: cabinets, pipes and conveyors remain visible and can communicate an industrial space. A main wall leaving a scrolling viewport is not itself an assembly defect.
